result._note: Reality for THIS pool team (Mikey/Ninja/Hilvi/Artor/Coldheart) at Dragon St16 — from 40 COMBINED captures (24 watcher battle-log + 16 manual victory-screen transcriptions, aggregated 2026-08-04), superseding the earlier 6-battle anchor. WIN RATE ~96% (watcher 23W/1L, manual 15W/1L). Wins median 104t (range 86-115). MEDIAN 5/5 SURVIVORS — the earlier '~2/5' was a small-sample artifact. Supports DO die, but only in a minority: death rate Ninja 0% / Mikey 4% / Coldheart 17% / Hilvi 22% / Artor 30% (n=23). Per-hero DEALT median (manual wins, n=15): Ninja 613k, Mikey 301k, Coldheart 223k, Hilvi 48k, Artor 27k. TAKEN med: Mikey 20k / Ninja 31k / Hilvi 37k / Coldheart 42k / Artor 43k. HEALING med: Ninja 147k / Artor 80k / Coldheart 24k / Mikey 22k / Hilvi 16k. Team-total dealt converges on ~1,226,226 (boss effective EHP). A faithful sim should land ~96% WR, MEDIAN 5/5 survivors (with support death rates ~17-30%), and — THE remaining gap — ~104 turns (the sim currently runs ~156, ~50% long).

reality_notes: POOL TEAM ~96% WR at St16 from 40 COMBINED captures (24 watcher + 16 manual, aggregated 2026-08-04): 23W/1L watcher, 15W/1L manual. Wins 86-115t, median 104. MEDIAN 5/5 survivors (supersedes the stale small-sample '2/5'); supports die only in a minority (Artor 30% / Hilvi 22% / Coldheart 17% / Mikey 4% / Ninja 0%). THE open sim gap is TURNS: sim median ~156 vs reality 104 (~50% long); WR and survivor count now MATCH. NOTE the in-game stat screen bakes in Arena (+6% base HP/ATK/DEF, measured); build-from-sync omits it, so battle_layers re-adds it below.

timeline.obs: wave 2 dies at turn 50 (25t per wave)
boss dies at turn 101 → boss phase = 51 turns; total fight 101t

_phase_reality_vs_sim: REALITY 25/25/51 (wave1/wave2/boss durations, total 101t) vs SIM masteries-off 36/42/106 (total 184t). Sim is slow in EVERY phase but worst on the BOSS: 106t vs 51t = 2.08× (waves 1.44×/1.68×). Boss deals the SAME 727k either way with ZERO self-heal — pure throughput deficit. Dominant cause = boss-damage MASTERIES off (Warmaster on waves + Giant Slayer on boss; masteries-on montecarlo = 118t total, near reality) + Ninja carry under-modeled. The extra boss turns are what give Coldheart 3-4 %maxHP A3 shots (reality 1-2).

battle_layers._note: Applied by sim-montecarlo's Dragon path (and any layer-aware run). auraSpdPct 0 = Michelangelo is an ACC leader, no SPD aura. accAura 70 = Michelangelo 'Increase ally ACC in All Battles' +70 (champion_auras, verified). arenaPct 0.06 = measured account HP/ATK/DEF account-bonus (screen vs base+gear = +6.0% of base on HP/ATK/DEF, nothing on RES/ACC/C.DMG → Arena; Great Hall ~0 on these affinities).
